questions: Are you here today because of a problem with your walking?
Did this walking problem start suddenly, over a matter of minutes or hours?
Has the walking problem been gradually worsening over the course of weeks or months?
Do you have any difficulty controlling your bladder, such as a sudden urge to urinate or leaking urine?
Have you noticed any new problems with your memory or ability to think clearly?
Do you develop pain, heaviness, or numbness in your legs or buttocks when you walk that goes away when you sit down or lean forward?
Do you experience numbness, tingling, or burning pain in your feet or lower legs?
Do you have a tremor or shaking in your hands, especially when they are at rest?
Have you or your family noticed that your overall movements have become slower than before?
Do you have a history of diabetes?
Do you have a history of high blood pressure, heart disease, or prior stroke?
Do you feel dizzy, lightheaded, or like the room is spinning when you walk?
Have you had any recent falls?
